name: i SCSI Security
description: Windows MDM settings in the i SCSI Security category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Do not allow changes to initiator CHAP secret
properties.description: If enabled then do not allow the initiator CHAP secret to be changed. If disabled then the initiator CHAP secret may be changed.

properties.name: Do not allow connections without IPSec
properties.description: If enabled then only those connections that are configured for IPSec may be established. If disabled then connections that are configured for IPSec or connections not configured for IPSec may be established.

properties.name: Do not allow sessions without mutual CHAP
properties.description: If enabled then only those sessions that are configured for mutual CHAP may be established. If disabled then sessions that are configured for mutual CHAP or sessions not configured for mutual CHAP may be established.

properties.name: Do not allow sessions without one way CHAP
properties.description: If enabled then only those sessions that are configured for one-way CHAP may be established. If disabled then sessions that are configured for one-way CHAP or sessions not configured for one-way CHAP may be established. Note that if the "Do not allow sessions without mutual CHAP" setting is enabled then that setting overrides this one.
